name: Sibir
storyline:
You are a government worker in the Sibir SSR. You have been assigned to work at the secret K-7 facility The directives keep arriving long after the ministry went quiet. Down here the paperwork is a comfort, the last thing that still behaves the way it should. Everything else has its own intentions and none of them mean you well, so go in alone if you like... or bring a crew
K-7 decides what walks back out...
